title: Evidence Debt: Reproducibility Package
description: Manuscript source, deterministic simulation, canonical synthetic data, a frozen census of 200 merged Argo CD pull requests and 30 releases, generated tables, an economic-accounting figure, and a field-study protocol for Evidence Debt. The public-repository observation establishes occurrence of a declared intent-link deficit; it is not an Evidence Debt, reconstruction-cost, or governance-quality measurement.
